name: Ogryn Loader Servitor

bonuses.name: Iron Soul
bonuses.text: This Threat is unaffected by abilities that target the mind, and never needs to make a Resolve Test to continue fighting.

abilities.name: Loading Prey
abilities.text: On its first Turn, an Ogryn Loader Servitor can Sprint towards its nearest enemy and attempts to Grapple them.

abilities.name: Error
abilities.text: The Servitor is Exhausted for 1 Round, This can be negated by an ally succeeding on a DN 3 Tech (Int) Test.

Upon death, Ignis Avem remotely overloads the Ogryn Loader's on-board power supply. Agents with a Passive Awareness of 4 or higher can detect the high-pitched whirring and glow of the capacitors overloading inside the Ogryn a Round before detonation. Ten seconds after the Loader Servitor has been defeated, it detonates with the following profile centered on its corpse: 10 +5 / Blast (6)

note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (9 Wounds, Large). The death explosion prints no range, kept as ability text, as Core's Killa Kan.
